review_description: Out of the three installers I contacted, I chose Goliath Solar because they were the most responsive, personable, and willing to provide a fully customised solution. They took the time to understand my needs as a homeowner and offered thoughtful recommendations tailored to my setup.Despite the complexity of my existing system—including three-phase SolarEdge inverters with a 15.7 kW solar array, a 22 kWh EV wall charger, and Clipsal C-Bus—their in-house installation team arrived on time, conducted themselves professionally, and completed the installation efficiently. Grid connection and commissioning were finalised the same day, allowing me to start using the battery immediately.Overall, I’m extremely satisfied with their service and expertise.
Every aspect of process was professional and friendly, great customer service and excellent installation. Happy to recommend.

Goliath were fantastic from initial enquiry through to the installation. I was replacing old solar panels and adding batteries.Goliath did a comprehensive site inspection which identified further work needed. An upgrade to the meter box and the grid connection was only 45 amps so that needed upgrading too. Goliath handled all of the paperwork and it was a smooth process across 3 different providers.Goliath have their own installation team and they removed all of the old gear and installed everything in 7 hour taking on board my input for where to locate the batteries and gateway. After the system was installed they ran through all aspects of the system including setting up the app on my phone. Several days later I received an email with all relevant instructions, documentation, warranty details for future reference.The system is working brilliantly and I am very happy with the result. I highly recommend Goliath Electrical.
Advice beforehand, the actual installation, and follow-up personal contact were efficient, timely, and appreciated. All staff were very helpful and courteous. Great installers. Thank you.

It was very professional from start to finish.He doesn’t care about selling heaps, he would but he checks your bill, recommends what we need with our daily usage and current lifestyle.Installation was good from start to finish.No, Dan does all that.This is our 3rd job with Dan, 2 Tesla batteries, 24 fronious panels and inverter later.My parents are also very happy with Dan and your teams works.Highly recommended and referred to friends and family knowing he would do a outstanding job and not let my referrel down

From the initial quote to the final installation, the entire experience was excellent. Tom and the team at Goliath was very prompt and professional throughout. The installation itself was carried out with great professionalism, leaving everything neat and tidy.This is the second time we've had an installation with them and we are very happy with both outcomes.

The system was quoted and designed, and due to house construction delays,  revised by the sales team to take up better technology and rebates. Making the system cheaper with a bigger battery.Installation team were polite friendly and cleaned up better than me.Connection paper work sorted and education and follow up helpful and in plain EnglishWould highly recommend this company and product.
Was excellent service well explained happy with everything always recommend

Goliath Solar and Electrical installed our solar system back in 2019.  We've always been very happy with the quality of both the installation and the equipment supplied.  So when it came time to add a home battery (thanks in part to the federal battery subsidy) it was a no brainer for us to use them again, given our very positive experience first time around.And 5 years down the line, I am very happy to say that they still provide the same quality of service.  Tom was very helpful in providing us with honest advice in choosing the right battery for our requirements over several chats.The scheduled installation went very smoothly, and so far we're very happy with the benefits of our new battery.  Goliath took care of all the necessary paperwork.  And the follow-up phone call a few days after the installation was much appreciated.Once again, I have no hesitation in recommending Goliath Solar and Electrical.

Sale and quote was really easy. Goliath knows exactly what I required and delivers a brilliant product. The installation crew were quick and efficient and explained the over of the system with me from meter box to app.

After moving into a new home with solar panels,  I wanted to take advantage of the current rebates. I shopped around, got quotes and found Goliath Solar the most responsive and professional to deal with, from the initial contact, to after the battery going online, Daniel especially was always on top of things, following up with me, answered all my questions. As it happens, they had installed the solar on the house I had purchased.On the way, the installers rocked up punctual and within a few hours it was all literally done and dusted. Cleaned up after themselves leaving no trace except for the new battery. One of the installers was the same person that actually installed the solar panels a few years ago. The fact that he was still there is testament to the company already treating their staff well.I would certainly recommend them to anyone wanting to get solar panels and/or battery installed.

The quoting process was straightforward and thorough. I was kept informed of the process the whole way through. The installers were friendly. They arrived on time and did a great job. They showed me how to do an emergency shut down. Follow up service since installation has been excellent which included help using the app. Overall a great company to deal with.
Excellent customer service throughout the process with thorough and clear information provided

The team at Goliath are simply a breath of fresh air. The process from initial contact, to quoting, right through to installation and follow up service is second to none.If you’re looking at anything to do with solar and batteries, do yourself a favour and make sure you contact Goliath. You won’t be disappointed, I’m thrilled with my system!

We had our 10.12kW solar system installed by Goliath Solar and Electrical 7 months ago.Dealing with Tom from the quoting process through to the installation was a great experience.Very professional, helpful, no pressure applied. He was always ready to answer all our questionsbefore and also after installation.Installation team was also very professional. Everything was completed efficiently and to a high standard.So far the solar system is flawless.Very happy with our choice of installer.

Goliath's Dan spent a lot of time talking me through different options to make sure I understood my choices ans that he understood what I was after in a solar panel and battery system. His team installed the system quickly and competently and I have been using it well ever since - it's exactly what I wanted from a team of locals I trust a lot. Definitely recommend Goliath to anyone thinking of installing solar panels and/or a battery.
We had Goliath install our solar about ten years ago, we were very happy back then and have been very happy with our battery installation just now.

Tom from Goliath did an outstanding job with my solar power installation. His excellent communication made the whole process simple and stress-free, and the customer service was second to none. Everything was explained clearly, the installation ran smoothly, and the results speak for themselves. Highly recommend Tom and the Goliath team
Really easy sales process. Neat and tidy installation and great after installation followup

Very easy to deal with, professional but down to earth. The process was seamless from initial call through to install and they gave options and recommendations across system size, model and location but also tweak to suit what you want. Chose Goliath based on the feedback from other installs and a demonstrated ability to resolve issues and continuously provide good service years after install.

Goliath Solar & Electrical have been excellent to deal with over the last 3 and a half years. They were referred to me by my daughter and son in law when they had their panels installed on their home in Panorama.I used SolarQuotes website to check on them and found they were genuine and already had great reviews. Well done Finn and team..Back in June 2022 after being totally dissatisfied with our 2kw inverter panel system and electricity prices soaring we engaged with Goliath about the potential for improvement.They checked our address and used imagery of our home to assess what could be done and came up with a system that could generate our needs and for the future.13.32kW solar systemCanadian Solar HiKu (Black Frame)2 Fronius Primo 5.0-1 (5kW) invertersConsumption Monitoring Device - Fronius Smart MeterGrasol - Grace RackingThis system, the quality of the products, the expert installation (which was completed in one day) was amazing and credit goes to the team and the customer service at Goliath, especially Ben who helped us through the whole process and answered my many questions.We did have a few issues over time but a quick call to Tom had him monitor what was occurring and he organised a technician (Liam?) to investigate one of our inverters promptly discovering the problem and organising a replacement part from Fronius. Quick and efficient.After ever increasing power prices and diminishing feed in tariffs, we decided it was time for a battery. Ben at Goliath had been telling us to wait as battery prices were still high, developments were improving and, as was substantiated by Finn in SolarQuotes, not really effective yet for value and cost of return.This all changed earlier this year when our bills were ever increasing and the FIT was atrocious.We organised with Goliath to have a Tesla PW3 installed after discussion with Ben about the benefits of other types including the PW2.This was in April/May just before the election and the Labor government's battery subsidy proposal.We asked Goliath to put our request on hold until after the election.They had a meeting and contacted their numerous battery proposal clients with an option to proceed with supply and installation after the election, which would incorporate the subsidy if Labor won or proceed if that wasn't the case. This resulted in the company Goliath securing supply before the on rush that occurred after the election.The subsidy also got us thinking that the original cost of one battery now almost covered 2 batteries, so we asked if we could purchase the Tesla PW3 expansion unit.Since our batteries were installed and switched on we have been receiving zero or negligible inputs from the grid and can now more efficiently charge our EV albeit with the granny chargerI think we were very fortunate to have a quality company like Goliath with their fully trained technicians and knowledgeable personnel in office to help and guide us along the way.Thanks guys, and SolarQuotes!

The team at Goliath Solar did a great installation, they were thorought with the quotes and conversations with me and on the 2 days they were here they checked with me about install location, going into the house and how it was all going.The system was installed very cleanly with good conduits for the large cabling for the 3 phase Sigenergy system and they left the site with no mess.This is the second install I've had with Goliath and they've been consistently great both times.The follow up emails and phone calls from Tom have also been appreciated and very insightful.

I used Goliath Solar and Electrical a number of years ago to install solar panels. The service I received was excellent so when I recently decided to install a battery I went straight to Goliath and have been extremely happy with the sales and service I received. Everybody I have had contact with from start to finish have been knowledgeable and helpful. So far all my dealings with them has been exemplary and I would recommend them without reservation.
Happy once again with Goliath Electrical.Every step from quote to instal and beyond has been made easy by the professional way they go about their business.

Tom was very patient over a long period of time. He is a wealth of information and took the time to explain the different battery options.The whole install was seamless with the connections and the electrician was tidy and made the effort to install without the cables showing.
Quotation process was clear and through.Installation was on time and professional.Customer service has been excellent.
I spoke to a few solar companies & found these guys the most knowledgeable. They helped me choose a good quality system, explained everything really well & the installation was quick and tidy.
Pricing was very transparent and on the website. This was much appreciated and the team did a great job and follow up.

Very professional company to deal with from the quotation stage through install and follow up once the system was operational. They kept me informed regularly from acceptance of quote until install as took time for the battery to arrive in Australia. The installers were very knowledgeable and did a great job and cleaned up thoroughly afterwards. Would highly recommend Tom and the team from Goliath!
They do what they say they are going to do and proactively follow up.We’ve used them twice now and are consistently happy with the outcome.Well done.

Tom at Goliath has provided another exceptional experience. They did my 13kwh panels and 8kwh Fronious system 5yrs ago, and just this week installed a Sigenergy 16kwh battery and 10kwh gateway system. Communication is always prompt, information is always true and transparent and Tom only designs the system I need for maximum value.The installers are top shelf and I have not a single issue with either system since install dates, not one drama!If I need after sales care, I ping Tom and he generally gives me a phone call within a day or so.Pricing is right on par. The staff are what win me over. Tom was ultra low pressure, yet very informative. Good contact leading up to and post install.The workers on site were also friendly and polite.Install seems neat. Quality products. Fronius and Canadian solar. They installed my system 10 years ago with no hassle, so were top of my list when I needed an upgrade. No regrets.

Goliath Solar installed my Tesla Power Wall battery, and from start to finish, the experience was seamless and professional.They took the time to explain every step of the process, ensuring I fully understood how everything would work. Their careful planning prior to the installation was impressive; they assessed my needs and tailored the solution to fit perfectly.Overall, Goliath Solar were professional and cost competitive. To have this backed up with great support and excellent communication makes them hard to look past if you're trying to find a reliable company to install a battery.
Great experience installing first panels and later a battery with Goliath Solar. Very professional on site and good communication from the office.

The sales and quoting process was excellent, Dan was very thorough, helpful and knowledgeable- he was able to provide a competitive quote and was flexible in considering our needs and configuring a system well designed for our property. The installation ran smoothly and punctually as planned- the team were very friendly, respectful, tidy and their communication was excellent. The follow up service has been as strong as the sales service and the whole process has been seamless. Thank you!

Installer turned up on time, explained what was about to occur. Any issues that the installer encountered, they stopped and explained how they were going tackle the problem. Once system installed, explained how to operate the battery application and how to interpret the data being shown on the app. Cleaned up and took away any rubbish. The whole process from receiving a quote to full installation was seamless. The after sales follow up and explanation was excellent.

Tom Morgan and his installation team have been fantastic liaising with our builder to install a PV array and battery system to suit our needs. Goliath was very patient and prepared to answer all of our questions to ensure that we achieved our solar objectives. The communication all through the design and installation process has been brilliant and very personal. Goliath also carries out regular checks to ensure the system is performing according to specifications.
Smooth process from start to finish!communication from the beginning to the end was great and after service very good! Installation and setup were spot on..

Goliath were incredibly good to deal with.Work was completed on time and things were left clean always.The thing that really impressed my family, that really stood out - was the clear communication and explanation about how the system worked.Goliath were also super honest and didn't try to upsell in any way whatsoever.
Great installer, quality product and the customer service is elite. Pro all round

In 2019 we installed 7.8 kw of solar panels with a Fronius inverter. We had a minor issue a couple of years ago, and Goliath actually contacted us about it, and sent an electrician out to fix it at no cost to us. The system is still performing very well, but our feed in tariff has dwindled over time. With the new battery rebate initiative,  we decided it was time to get some storage, and Goliath ( Tom, the owner) provided a comprehensive quote for a Tesla unit with 13.5 kw hours of usable power. They were able to fit it very promptly-in fact we are set up for commissioning well before the scheme start date of 1 July 2025. The install was pretty labour intensive, but Jordan and Lewis, who are employed by Goliath, did a really neat job of placing the battery and gateway box in an ideal exterior location, given that room was tight in our courtyard home’s garage. The lads even cleaned up very thoroughly at jobs end. I’ll write another update on how the battery system performs after commissioning, but given the previous solar panel install and the job thus far I’m very confident of a successful outcome.

From day one communication with Goliath has been fantastic. They have provided a lot of information with the solar system/battery and the process. I have had a few different trades doing work lately and the Goliath guys were easily the best. All the workers were punctual great to deal with, polite and at the end of the job you would not know they had been there. They left no mess! I definitely would recommend Goliath Electrical.

Sales/quoting process was good….. no pressure applied.Installation went well, they were friendly, polite and helpful.  Cleaned up on leaving.Assistance continues after installation and encouraged to ask questions (even in the future).Over all a good experience and I am happy with the system thus far.Would be happy to recommend Goliath.

Tom has extensive product knowledge & explains everything so it’s easy to understand. Installers are always polite, professional & mindful of cleaning areas where they have worked. The follow up calls at a time you choose after installation are also great so you can use the product for a few days then go over any questions you may then have. Overall the whole team takes pride in what they do which is very commendable these days.

A great small business, didn't get the hard sell, this is so refreshing. They provided factual advice, and unbiased reading material to help you make a decision. Installation crew were a hard working team, polite and respectful, as a female at home by myself, I felt comfortable. I was kept up to date with the process throughout the day. The placing of cables/conduit was neat and well thought out. I was shown how to use the app and they organised the grid connection.  Awesome!

Excellent quote process. Quick installation and great work carried out

We had a great experience with Goliath Solar & Electrical. Tom was extremely helpful throughout the quoting process—very knowledgeable, patient, and made everything clear and easy to understand. The installation team did a fantastic job as well. We are really happy with the quality of the installation and the professionalism of the crew. Everything was completed efficiently and to a high standard. Highly recommend Goliath for anyone considering solar!

The options provided where clear so that in making a decision we were confident that the installation would meet our needs and budget. Goliath provided comprehensive guidance throughout the installation process, addressing all my inquiries and concerns. I highly recommend their services. It is advisable to avoid reputable solar companies that may close down before the warranty expires.

Tom and his team were absolutely fantastic, they helped me so quickly with the highest standards.This is the second time Tom has helped me and the team just keeps getting better.I highly recommend Tom for any Solar Panels, Inverters and batteries, you won't be disappointed.

Being a tradie myself i am fussy and OCD with straight lines and ascetics...Our salesman Tom walked us thru operational details after install and will follow up again in a weeks time after our energy provider does their remote access login....Very happy & pleased with the whole process.Fully recommend them to allPictures doesnt do them justiceLooks perfect IRLThanks Goliath TeamCheersBrett

Very professional.The have an excellent customer service where they help us organise the grid connections after the installation and show us how to use the app and also guide us to choose the best electric supplier that will give us good tariff. Goliath Servhce is very professional.6.6kw- Canadian panelsFronius inverter 5kw

After contacting the team at Goliath they swiftly provided us a fair/transparent quote. Installation of the system was efficient. I was recommended Goliath by numerous friends and colleagues.  They certainly met our expectations with quality, price and service. The installation team was polite, punctual and very helpful. The after sales service has been excellent. I will continue to recommend them to others. Jon Wright

The Team at Goliath provided exceptional customer service, designed and installed a solar system to meet the heritage requirements of my suburb and helped with the development application processUsing high quality products matched with industry knowledge you can see why these guys are the real deal

The team installed a Powerwall 3 and some panels in a morning! They were organised and neat. It could not have went better. Tom was very helpful in talking through the various options and planning the installation for the team too.

Dan was brilliant from the outset, explaining the process and coordinating the installation and set-up of the system. His communication was outstanding. Very friendly and professional team. Sam, Zach, Lewis, Tom and the other members of the team we interacted with were great.Offered a great deal for a really quality system. Customer support is excellence. Highly recommend. Even helped with getting a good deal on the feed in tariffs.
